reviews.review_msg: This is one of my favourite classes I have taken at Simon Fraser University. Dr. Brown's lectures were always interesting, grading was fair, and he was very caring and understanding. The history conference that we attended for Essay #2 was also an incredible experience. I strongly recommend taking a class with Dr. Brown.
Dr. Brown was a spectacular prof, he is inspiring and loves to teach. If you want to learn take his classes.
One of the best prof at SFU, if you show him you made effort, good mark guaranteed. Take classes with Jeremy.
